sentences.en: It was such a shock to her that she collapsed.
sentences.zh: 她受到的打击太大了，当场晕倒。

sentences.en: His flawlessly ordered life collapsed when his drug-addict brothers appeared.
sentences.zh: 他的完美生活在他吸毒成瘾的兄弟出现后彻底崩溃了。

sentences.en: If there's a big earthquake, the house could really collapse!
sentences.zh: 如果发生大地震，房子真的可能会坍塌！

mnemonic: 联想记忆：col+lapse（滑倒）→一出门就滑倒，真让人崩溃→崩溃
